text:
Riley: tiny festive idea  'Hot Cocoa Ladder' + origami ornament exchange next Wednesday 3:10pm. ladder = people stand in a line and hand a cup up the chain (no open flames), origami = bring one paper ornament to swap. low-key and cozy. :hot_beverage::snowflake:

Noor: love the ladder idea. is it safe for hot liquids? maybe we do insulated travel mugs only?

Riley: yes insulated-only rule. i'll bring a kettle and insulated cups. official rule: fill at the kettle, pass carefully, no pouring between cups while moving.

Sam: i'm in for origami. can we make a small tutorial station? i have origami cheat-sheets.

Devin: count me in. quick logistics q: will there be sugar-free cocoa? i can bring a batch.

BotChef: Reminder: Event created "Hot Cocoa Ladder + Origami Swap" Wed 15:10. Reply 'join' to RSVP.

Riley: signup (copy/paste):
```
Name  ladder OR origami OR both  snack/allergy note (optional)
```

Noor: Noor  ladder  none

Sam: Sam  origami  gluten-free biscotti (contains nuts)

Devin: Devin  both  sugar-free cocoa option

Riley: tiny safety note: if you bring a kettle or extension cord, mark it here. we have limited outlets.

Noor: i can bring a 3m extension and a surge strip.

Sam: ooh prize idea: best origami ornament gets a tiny enamel pin. sound good? :star2:

Devin: yes pin please. also can we do a 30s charm-story for each ornament? like who it's for or a silly name.

Riley: love charm-story. remote folks welcome for a 30s camera cameo. react :wave: if you want a cameo slot.

Noor: :wave:

Sam: :wave:

Devin: logistics: reception can hold dropoffs labelled "cocoa-ladder" for 24 hours. please mark allergens on any snacks.

Riley: poll quick: do we want background carols? react :musical_note: yes, :mute: no.

Noor: :musical_note:

Sam: :musical_note:

Devin: :mute: (i'm mixing cocoa)

Riley: carols on. final tiny ask: bring a mug cozy if you have one  purely aesthetic. :sweater:

BotChef: Automated reminder will post 1 hour before the event. Add to calendar? Reply 'yes'.

Sam: Sam  origami  gluten-free biscotti (contains nuts)

Devin: Devin  both  sugar-free cocoa

Noor: Noor  ladder  none

Riley: thanks team  bringing extra napkins and a spill kit. see you for a safe, cozy ladder and some tiny folded magic. :hot_beverage::sparkles:
